address: Plas Dinas Country House, Bontnewydd, Caernarfon, Gwynedd,LL54 7YF
bio: Treat yourself to Afternoon Tea at Plas Dinas, a beautiful Grade II listed Country House dating, back to the mid-seventeenth century.  The house has a rich history, with connections to the Royal family and still retains the ambience of a genuine Welsh gentleman's country residence, largely unspoilt by its conversion to luxury accommodation.  Choose from two menus - Signature Afternoon Tea and Snowdon's Afternoon Tea...  Both menus start with a selection of delicate handmade sandwiches on freshly baked bread, followed by a Welsh rarebit & leek crumpet.  The savouries continue on the Snowdon's Afternoon Tea menu, with Game sausage roll and Snowdonia Wagyu slider with smoked bacon jam & Snowdonia red devil cheese.  Both menus follow with warm and crumbly plain and fruit scones served with clotted cream and preserves. The final course is a delicious assortment of sweets including traditional Bara birth with Welsh butter and a white chocolate & pumpkin cremaux with pumpkin seed granola.  Situated in the stunningly picturesque North Wales countryside, between the Menai Straits and Snowdonia mountain range, Plas Dinas is a short drive away from some of the country's best views, beaches and castles.
